content.overview: Section 23 determines the annual value of house property, including deemed let-out and self-occupied treatment.
content.glance: Section 23 determines the annual value of house property, including deemed let-out and self-occupied treatment.
content.study: Annual value is determined from the sum for which the property might reasonably be expected to let, the actual rent, and the vacancy and unrealised-rent adjustments in section 23. Self-occupied property has a nil annual value subject to the stated limit.
